id: title:dmarchuk:give batch audience page queries their own clickhouse cap

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a bounded execution time configuration for ClickHouse query workflows, potentially preventing resource exhaustion and improving reliability of batch audience queries.
review.reason: Adds a configuration variable and its application to ClickHouse execution settings, establishing a bounded timeout for query execution. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the bounded memory settings or the full context of the batch resolver's interaction with ClickHouse, so the exact operational behavior and complete implementation cannot be verified. The benefit relies on the supplied configuration being correctly wired and effective, which is not fully demonstrated in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the definition or implementation of the ClickHouse query execution or the bounded memory settings, nor does it show the complete context of the batch resolver's interaction with ClickHouse. The score cannot be assigned without seeing the actual query execution and the bounded memory settings implementation.
